overview.description: The Xtrackers Bloomberg Developed Markets ex US Equity ETF (DMXU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. EASG tracks a principles-based, market-cap-weighted index of stocks from developed markets outside of the US and Canada. DMXU was launched on Sep 6, 2018 and is issued by Xtrackers.
